# Noobot v4.3.3

This release adds user interjections and visual configuration, optimizes the codebase, and fixes bugs.

- Add user interjections so users can provide additional instructions during an active turn, with ordered persistence and refresh recovery.
- Add a visual configuration interface for managing system and workspace settings.
- Optimize protocol, session, event, runtime, plugin, and frontend code paths.
- Fix bugs affecting session lifecycle, stop and resume behavior, reconnect handling, configuration processing, and concurrent operations.
